_comment: License registry. The six with listed !== false are the featured grants on /license (PD, WC, and the four CC flavours). Custom entries (listed: false) are also valid song.json license ids — they appear on the song page with may/mayNot/must checkboxes and a link to legalUrl, not on the hub. tools/validate.mjs accepts any id here. For CC licenses the legal code at legalUrl controls and is never restated. Vendored into WorshipCommons/src/licenses.json — keep the two copies byte-identical. Placeholders in "notice": {year} {writer} {version} {licenseUrl} (a song's own licenseUrl, else deedUrl).

licenses.label: Public domain
may: Sing, print, project, record, and stream it
Arrange, transpose, and translate it
Sell your own arrangement or recording
Use it in any media
licenses.notice: Public domain. Free for every use, including commercial.

licenses.label: Free for worship
may: Sing, play, project, and print it in worship
Transpose, arrange, and translate it
Record or stream your service, live or later
Skip a verse or repeat a part
mayNot: Sell recordings or sheet music
Release it as a track, album, or music video
Use it in film, TV, ads, podcasts, or games
Change what the song means
licenses.notice: WorshipCommons License v{version}: free for worship everywhere, always. https://worshipcommons.org/license

licenses.label: CC BY
may: Sing, print, project, record, and stream it
Arrange, transpose, and translate it
Sell your own arrangement or recording
Use it in any media
mayNot: Remove the credit
Pretend you wrote it
must: Name the license (CC BY, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips

licenses.label: CC BY-SA
may: Sing, print, project, record, and stream it
Arrange, transpose, and translate it
Sell your own arrangement or recording
Use it in any media
mayNot: Remove the credit
Pretend you wrote it
Release a translation or arrangement under a tighter license
must: Name the license (CC BY-SA, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips
Share your derivatives (translations, arrangements you distribute) under CC BY-SA too

licenses.label: CC BY-NC
may: Sing, project, print, transpose, arrange, and translate it in a worship gathering that is not sold as a product
Take an ordinary offering during the service
mayNot: Sell recordings or sheet music
Use it in ads
Put it on a stream or video that is monetized (YouTube ads, paid download, ticketed live)
Use it in a conference or product people pay to attend as the product
must: Name the license (CC BY-NC, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips

licenses.label: CC BY-NC-SA
may: Sing, project, print, transpose, arrange, and translate it in a worship gathering that is not sold as a product
Take an ordinary offering during the service
mayNot: Sell recordings or sheet music
Use it in ads
Put it on a stream or video that is monetized (YouTube ads, paid download, ticketed live)
Use it in a conference or product people pay to attend as the product
Release a translation or arrangement under a tighter license
must: Name the license (CC BY-NC-SA, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips
Share your derivatives (translations, arrangements you distribute) under CC BY-NC-SA too

licenses.label: Custom — Larry Holder Music
may: Sing, print, and project it in worship
Copy it for non-profit church use
Make internal arrangements for your band
Record or stream a non-profit service
Make a non-profit recording (free, at cost, or ministry proceeds)
mayNot: Translate it without asking the writer
Change the lyrics or melody
Use it on a for-profit site or a page with ads
Sell recordings or sheet music as a commercial product
must: Keep the original credits and copyright notice on every copy
Credit Larry Holder / Larry Holder Music
licenses.notice: Shared by Larry Holder Music for non-profit church use. Keep the original credits. Full terms: {licenseUrl}
